specification_compliance: I1: every query in addons/intelligence/app/exact_search.py filters on `f.drive = :drive AND f.active = 1` (_IN_DRIVE, line 76) for text, transcript, scene hits and both scene-ranking queries.
I2: matching uses `instr(lower(col), lower(:q)) > 0` (line 75), so %, _ and \ are literal; total is len(all hits) and paging slices the fully sorted list (line 192-193).

I3: match_count uses str.count on ASCII-folded text (non-overlapping); _snippet takes 80 chars each side and adds an ellipsis only at a cut end (lines 39-44). ASCII folding preserves length so offsets align.
I4: rank_scenes restricts to embedding_type = 'video_visual_scene', active runs (r.is_active = 1), active files of the drive, and sorts by descending score before truncating to limit (line 277-278).
I5: both code paths use get_search_db_read and only SELECT; scene search calls embed_query (embedding, not an LLM).
I7: manifest.json lines 250-273 declare pre_check addon_feature `search` for both routes.
I8: EPUB rows put page into section with page null; others into page; transcripts LEFT JOIN transcript_chunks on chunk_index; scene segments carry `field`.

I9: _visual_index_open returns False when global setting is 'false' or the drive policy is off or the policy call fails (default_on_failure=False, exceptions swallowed to False); /search/scenes then 404s and /search/exact excludes scenes.

I10: mcp-server/src/tools/search.ts encodes X-Lit-Drive with encodeURIComponent, passes only given params, strips `available`, and zod bounds match server bounds (q 1-200 / 1-1000, limit 1-200 / 1-50, offset >= 0).
potential_unspecified_behavior: Zod `q` min(1) counts unstripped length while the server strips; a whitespace-only q passes zod and gets a server 422, which is a server-side error rather than a client-side rejection (arguably within I10 since a request is made for an in-bounds argument).
regression_risks: find_exact loads every matching row of the drive into memory before paging; a very common short q in a large drive could be slow, bounded by the 30s proxy timeout.
